title: File:KarlsruheKITcampusNord2019-04-20-12-00-14.jpg
desc: Aerial view of the North Campus of the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology. The area is still a permanent restricted area (ED-R 133) due to its past as the Karlsruhe Nuclear Research Centre; hence a telephoto image.
